minutes.headline: Board unanimously accepted a Cordish surrounding-community amendment adding a one-time payment; denied conditional license for Donnelly's Tavern.
minutes.summary: Last meeting of 2013. Members urged support for the combined middle/high school project at the January 7 special town meeting and January 11 ballot. The board approved annual business licenses, refused a conditional license for a business with unpaid taxes, and amended the surrounding communities agreement with the Cordish company. Committee reports covered capital planning, the village bylaw and the planning board's vote on the school project.

what_happened.line: The Select Board unanimously accepted an amendment to the surrounding communities agreement with Cordish, giving Lunenburg a one-time payment while keeping its annual payment.
The board would not issue a conditional license to Donnelly's Tavern while taxes are unpaid; it can be signed on January 7 once they are paid.
The board approved the annual business licenses in a series of votes, including entertainment, victualer, alcohol, package goods and limousine licenses; the package goods vote was not audible.
Members urged support for the combined middle/high school project at the January 7 special town meeting and the January 11 ballot.
The Townsend net metering credits agreement stayed on hold pending information from Unitil.

why_it_matters: The Cordish amendment changes what Lunenburg receives from the casino developer, which is money that can support town services; Bolton's annual fee also rises under the same amendment.

The school project vote at the special town meeting and the ballot is one residents will be asked to take, and members said its funding sits outside the operating budget, which the town manager projected would run deficits.
Licensees with unpaid taxes must settle them before the board issues a license, so the board is collecting on bills owed to the town.
watch_next: January 7 special town meeting, where the next Select Board meeting will be held at the high school and Donnelly's Tavern's license can be signed once taxes are paid.
January 11 ballot vote on the combined middle/high school project.
